title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Rating Reserve at Account Closing
content:
**Rating reserve — Cartwise Shopper Payouts account closing**

§1 On the closing of a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account, a rating reserve is held back from the final disbursement for 30 days: 20.00 for two or more one-star customer ratings in the last 3 months, 10.00 for exactly one, and nothing for none.

§2 The ratings counted are the customer ratings of one star received on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Ratings of two stars or more are not counted.

§3 "The last 3 months" counts the ratings booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the closing.

§4 Condition — result:

| One-star customer ratings in the last 3 months | Rating reserve |
|---|---|
| None | None |
| Exactly one | 10.00 |
| Two or more | 20.00 |

§5 Hypothetical applications.

- (i) One one-star rating received 5 weeks before closing and one received 4 months before closing: one falls in the window, so the rating reserve is 10.00.
- (ii) Three one-star ratings in the last 3 months: 20.00.
- (iii) Several two-star ratings and no one-star rating in the last 3 months: no rating reserve.
